record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, add a fixed residual path from the normalized item embedding to its corresponding GRU output: z_t = h_t + 0.25*e_t, using the embedding before input dropout. Apply this representation at existing supervised positions and the final-real-position inference readout. Direct access to the latest observed item may complement recurrent context when predicting short-term transitions. Preserve embedding parameterization, sequence policy, dot-product scoring, loss and optimizer. Retain one jointly trained GRU model per category and update the predictor writer.
